_comment: TestScope MCP registration for IBM Bob IDE.
command points at the project virtualenv because the oracle and the gate execute pytest;
the interpreter running the server is also the interpreter handed to those subprocesses.
Path is absolute by design (Bob documents absolute args); update it if the repository moves.
alwaysAllow contains EXACTLY three tools: the pure read-only ones. testscope_gate is NOT
auto-approved because it is the only tool that touches test files - the human click is the
trust boundary expressed in the permission model.
